name: Adamantinoma

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Histopathological and radiological diagnostic criteria for adamantinoma

criteria.description: Presence of characteristic epithelial cell nests within a fibrous stroma on biopsy
Radiographic evidence of a well-defined, multilocular, lytic lesion predominantly in the tibial diaphysis
Positive cytokeratin staining confirming epithelial differentiation
Chronic localized swelling and pain in the affected long bone

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological confirmation of epithelial nests with supportive radiological findings and immunohistochemical positivity for cytokeratin
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires biopsy and immunohistochemical confirmation due to overlap with other bone tumors.

laboratory: Normal routine blood tests; no specific serum markers
Possible mild elevation of inflammatory markers if secondary infection
imaging: X-ray showing multilocular, lytic lesion with sclerotic margins in tibial diaphysis
MRI demonstrating cortical destruction and soft tissue involvement
CT scan for assessment of pulmonary metastases
genetic: No consistent genetic mutations identified; cytogenetic studies may show complex karyotypes
other: Histopathology revealing epithelial nests within fibrous stroma

distinguishingFeatures: Lacks epithelial cell nests on biopsy
Radiographically less aggressive with no soft tissue mass
Histology shows malignant epithelial cells with atypia

references: World Health Organization Classification of Tumours: Soft Tissue and Bone Tumours, 5th Edition, 2020
Campanacci M. Bone and Soft Tissue Tumors. 2nd Edition. 1999.
